description: This file defines the 'Create' class within the GuzzleHttp\Promise namespace. The class provides static methods to generate and handle promises, including creating fulfilled, rejected, or new promises based on different input types, as well as utility functions for iterators.

classes.name: Create
classes.description: A final class providing static factory methods for creating promises and iterator utilities within the GuzzleHttp Promise namespace.

methods.name: promiseFor
methods.description: Creates a promise for a value if the value is not already a promise.

methods.name: rejectionFor
methods.description: Creates a rejected promise for a reason, or returns the provided promise if it already is one.

methods.name: exceptionFor
methods.description: Creates an exception for a rejected promise value.

methods.name: iterFor
methods.description: Returns an iterator for the given value, wrapping arrays and non-iterator values appropriately.
